text:
Denise Harper: Heads-up — Meridian EBR on 2026-03-31. Draft deck uploaded, but we need to lock exec talking points and a mitigation plan for onboarding churn. Link: https://drive.redwood/meridian/ebr-draft (please don't share externally)
Samir Patel: Pinging to confirm: onboarding NPS dipped to 6 last month, right? that’s our main renewal flag.
Olivia Chen: Yep — NPS 6, onboarding completion stalled at 68%, usage of key embed endpoint down ~27% MoM. I put a short ops summary in slide 4.
Matt Rivera: I can pull cost & latency deltas for the last 6 weeks to show perf impact vs baseline. Want that in the exec slide? @Denise
Denise Harper: Yes — single slide w/ 2 bullets: 1) customer impact (NPS + usage) 2) proposed mitigations + ask. Keep it <120s for execs.
Ebrahima Diallo: Quick thought: chief blocker is the workspace provisioning race condition from the onboarding flow. We have a patch but need a canary rollout window.
Samir Patel: Action: @Ebrahima to own Canary rollout plan + ETA (target: 3/25). @Matt to add perf numbers (3/27). @Olivia to run a targeted enablement workshop with platform team (3/26). @Denise to draft exec ask and backup metrics (3/28).
Olivia Chen: I'll do a 45-min workshop recording + 1-pager. Who should I invite from Meridian? suggest: A. Kwan (platform), L. Ruiz (product), CSM contact: Jordan.
Denise Harper: Include Jordan and add a short pre-read. Also call out the renewal cadence — renewal window opens 4/01.
reminder-bot: Reminder: Meridian EBR scheduled in 7 days — owner: Denise Harper. (automated)
Samir Patel: Need one clear ask for execs: either 1) approve emergency engineering SLA & priority patch, or 2) approve 8-week enablement engagement with dedicated SE time. Pick one in the slide.
Denise Harper: Draft ask text for both options: put both but highlight primary ask as #1. I'll create an A/B decision box for execs.
Matt Rivera: For slide visuals, I'll export a simple chart: "Active API calls (7d avg)" and "Onboarding completions" with arrows. Will commit asset to drive by EOD 3/27.
Ebrahima Diallo: Canary rollout plan (short):
```
- 3/23: smoke tests in staging
- 3/24: 5% canary in prod (EU region)
- 3/25: full rollout if no regressions
owner: Ebrahima
```
Denise Harper: Perfect. Final ask: owners and due dates in the slide footer. I'll update the deck after you drop assets. Who's ok to review final deck 3/29 morning? @Samir @Olivia @Matt
Samir Patel: I can review 3/29 AM.
Olivia Chen: Yep, 3/29 AM works for me.
Matt Rivera: Works.
Denise Harper: Thanks team — I'll post a short meeting invite for a 20-min dry run on 3/30. Please react when you have uploaded your pieces :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Uploaded perf chart (v1) :thumbsup:
Olivia Chen: Uploaded workshop agenda + pre-read link :thumbsup:
Ebrahima Diallo: Canary plan doc uploaded.
Denise Harper: Great — closing this thread and moving tasks into the renewal tracker. Will follow up if exec prep needs tweaks.
